text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Was that just now... dark magic!?
A-Are you trying to block our way home!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Either that, or... c-could it be... a paranormal phenomenon...?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A classmate told me about it!
The window of the old science prep room was glowing green...
and a voice was chanting, "Salvation~ Salvation~"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-Th-That cannot be resolved
with a punch~~!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... I-I'm fine!
My big sister told me a trick for this back then!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Remember the person you can rely on the most!"
If you have a strong ally, it'll be cautious and won't attack!
So—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things were tough,
you were always there with me...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Putting me first whatever we did,
always there to help me out with anything—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She teaches me everything—how to run fast,
how to battle strong opponents, and the tenacity to never give up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So it's totally okay now♡
Both of you, follow me!
And so, Vivlos and the others conquered their fear of the dark and made it safely back to the dorms—
